glosses: lecture, talk (spoken lesson or exposition, usually delivered to a group)
palaestra (public area in ancient Greece and Rome dedicated to the teaching and practice of wrestling and other sports)

examples.text: A que horas começa a palestra?
As palestras dele são muito longas.
A palestra dele começou no horário.
De fato, sua palestra foi chata.
examples.en: As a matter of fact, his lecture was boring.

examples.text: Quando chegamos a palestra já havia começado.
examples.en: When we arrived, the lecture had already begun.
